page_title: BAY 6-0 RBL | Bayern Munich v RB Leipzig 22/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Florian Badstubner is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' Romulo Cardoso (RB Leipzig) leaps highest to meet the resulting corner and attempts to head home, but the effort goes harmlessly wide of the left post.
90+4' Good work from RB Leipzig as they win a corner.
90+4' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
90+4' There's an opportunity for Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
90+2' Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) zig-zags his way into the box and fails to direct a shot inside the right post as the goalkeeper pulls off a miraculous stop.
90+2' Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) commits a foul and Florian Badstubner immediately signals a free kick.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
88' Ole Werner decides to make a substitution. Nicolas Seiwald will be replaced by Assan Ouedraogo (RB Leipzig).
87' That's a clear yellow card. Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) goes into the book.
87' Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
86' Jonah Kusi Asare (Bayern Munich) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Harry Kane.
81' Unlucky! A great strike from Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) near the edge of the box had the keeper scrambling but flew just over the bar.
81' A quickly taken corner by Bayern Munich.
80' Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) has an effort from distance and sends the ball towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper is equal to it.

78' 6 - 0 GOAL! Superb work from Min-Jae Kim, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Harry Kane (Bayern Munich), who beats Peter Gulacsi with a brilliant shot into the bottom right corner. 6:0.
74' 5 - 0 Goal! Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) is teed up on the edge of the box by Luis Diaz, and his howitzer of a shot into the bottom right corner gives the keeper no chance. 5:0.
72' Celebrations are cut short for RB Leipzig as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
69' The goal for RB Leipzig is subject to a VAR review by the referee! He's obviously unsure or he received a message.
69' A substitution has been made. Serge Gnabry goes off and Lennart Karl (Bayern Munich) comes on.
69' Ole Werner has decided to substitute Johan Bakayoko and he is replaced by Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig).
69' Here is a change. Xaver Schlager is going off and Ole Werner gives the last tactical orders to Ezechiel Banzuzi (RB Leipzig).
69' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Konrad Laimer walks off the pitch to be replaced by Sacha Boey (Bayern Munich).
68' Substitution. Jonathan Tah makes his way off the pitch and Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich) comes on as his replacement.
68' The manager makes a subsitution with Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) coming on for Leon Goretzka.
68' The whistle is blown for an infringement and Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) receives a yellow card!
66' Goal! Johan Bakayoko displays great vision and sends a pass to Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the top of the net. The score is 4:1.

64' 4 - 0 Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Peter Gulacsi is just a bystander as the ball flies low into the middle of the goal. The score is 4:0.
63' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
62' PENALTY APPEAL after Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
62' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) steadies himself on the edge of the box and releases a precise effort on goal that just narrowly sails past the right post.
60' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) unleashes a decent effort from just outside the box which goes narrowly wide of the left post.
59' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
58' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Nicolas Seiwald (RB Leipzig) inside the box.
54' A cross by Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
52' RB Leipzig will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
52' Ridle Baku (RB Leipzig) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
51' Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
49' This is a yellow card! Jonathan Tah (Bayern Munich) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
48' Michael Olise received a sweet pass from Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich), but the advance is stopped.
47' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
46' The ball spins to Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) on the edge of the box. He hits across the ball and sends it goalwards, but it goes just wide of the left post.
46' The game is over for Lois Openda (RB Leipzig). Romulo Cardoso comes on for the second half.
46' Ole Werner makes a switch. Antonio Nusa (RB Leipzig) is coming on in place of Yan Diomande at the start of the second period.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+6' Florian Badstubner has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+6' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) times his run well and connects with a cross on the edge of the six-yard box, but can't keep the ball down and it flies high over the bar.
45+6' Bayern Munich take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
45+6' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich).
45+5' The referee awards a corner and David Raum (RB Leipzig) goes over to take it.
45+5' Johan Bakayoko (RB Leipzig) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
45+4' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
45+4' There is a free kick near the sideline to Bayern Munich. Ridle Baku (RB Leipzig) tackles a bit over-zealously and Florian Badstubner blows for a foul.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' The ball is cleared after Johan Bakayoko (RB Leipzig) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

44' Xaver Schlager (RB Leipzig) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
42' 3 - 0 Goal - 3:0! Serge Gnabry laid the ball off to Michael Olise (Bayern Munich), who shot from close range into the bottom right corner, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
41' The resulting corner, taken by Michael Olise (Bayern Munich), comes to nothing.
41' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
40' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) wastes a promising chance! He tries his luck with a shot from mid-range, but his effort hits the crossbar! A few inches lower and it could have been a sweet goal!
40' 66:34 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
38' Florian Badstubner blows his whistle and it's Willi Orban (RB Leipzig) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
36' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
36' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) takes the resulting free kick from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by the players standing in the wall, saving the goalkeeper a lot of effort.
35' Bayern Munich have been awarded a free kick just outside the penalty area, in a dangerous position.
34' Willi Orban (RB Leipzig) has tested the patience of referee Florian Badstubner and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

32' 2 - 0 Goal! Luis Diaz (Bayern Munich) latches on to a superb pass inside the box, finds himself in a promising position and fires a shot in off the inside of the right post. The goalkeeper was helpless to keep out his effort.
30' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
29' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) takes the corner.
27' Goal! Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the left side of the goal. It's 1:0.

25' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from the penalty spot wasn't accurate enough and the ball went a few inches wide of the left post.
22' Good movement by Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for RB Leipzig.
18' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Peter Gulacsi stops the ball from going inside the left post.
17' The Bayern Munich players are exchanging some short passes.
14' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) is flagged for offside.
12' Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.

11' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the middle of the goal. Peter Gulacsi guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
10' Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) is adjudged offside.
7' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
6' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
5' Yan Diomande (RB Leipzig) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Florian Badstubner who sees an offensive foul.
4' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.

4' Michael Olise (Bayern Munich) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear. The ball goes out of play and Bayern Munich have been awarded a corner kick.
1' The match has just started.
Bayern Munich will kick-off.
Florian Badstubner is the one to supervise the game today.
